channel.title: New York Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New York Daily News (nydailynews.com)

item.title: Fired employee indicted for setting blaze to Long Island pizzeria
item.description: A former Long Island pizzeria employee has been indicted for trying to burn the eatery to the ground after getting fired from his job.

item.title: Former mayor’s son Dante de Blasio among dozens arrested at Manhattan anti-ICE hotel protest
item.description: Dante, 29, was charged with criminal trespassing and disorderly conduct after he refused to obey NYPD orders to vacate the lobby of the Hilton Garden Inn Tribeca on Sixth Ave. near West Broadway around 6 p.m. Tuesday, sources said.

item.title: St. John’s extends winning streak to seven with coast-to-coast victory over Butler
item.description: There was no need Wednesday night for another furious second-half comeback.

item.title: TikTok star Ms. Shirley Raines, beloved homeless advocate, dies at 58
item.description: Shirley Raines, a social media creator and nonprofit founder who dedicated her life to caring for people experiencing homelessness, has died at age 58.

item.title: The Jets interview five candidates for offensive coordinator position
item.description: Aaron Glenn reached out to Frank Reich about joining the Jets staff in some capacity, per source.

item.title: Islanders roll past Rangers 5-2 in Ondrej Palat’s first game
item.description: The Rangers host the Islanders on Thursday for the second half of a home-and-home.

item.title: Candace Owens leaks ‘off-putting’ audio of Erika Kirk in wake of husband’s killing
item.description: Candace Owens has leaked audio from a conference call in which Erika Kirk expressed an "upbeat" attitude less than two weeks after the assassination of her husband.

item.title: Mikal Bridges erupts for 30 points, takes accountability in Knicks’ win vs. Raptors
item.description: The Knicks used a 25-4 third-quarter run to turn a 12-point deficit into a 119-92 victory.

item.title: Lawsuit targets NYPD car stops as racially discriminatory, likened to ‘stop and frisk on wheels’
item.description: Blacks and Hispanics made up 90% of arrests resulting from NYPD car stops, the suit says, despite accounting for only 45% of the driving population.

item.title: NYPD investigating car driving into Chabad’s Brooklyn headquarters as hate crime
item.description: Video posted online shows a Honda sedan repeatedly slamming into an entrance to the Chabad headquarters, with the driver backing up and then accelerating into a pair of double doors multiple times.
